description: Plan de sécurité routière 2024-2029 is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Le Plan Sécurité Routière 2024-2029 du Département de l’Hérault définit une stratégie globale pour réduire durablement les accidents et sauver des vies sur les routes. Fondé sur le principe de la "Vision Zéro", il place la vie humaine au cœur des politiques de mobilité. Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Routes, Transports et Mobilités. Its keywords are routes, sécurité routière, mobilité, Accidentologie. The portal shows 1 records. The portal shows 2025-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
